options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Champions
options.doc: Which champions are possibly included in the item pool?

options.name: Starting Champions
options.doc: Number of champions in your starting inventory
options.doc_fr: Nombre de champions dans votre inventaire de départ

options.name: Champion Subset Count
options.doc:
Number of champions to randomly select for the item pool of those listed provided.
Higher then the total number of champions will just use all champions listed.
options.doc_fr:
Nombre de champions à choisir au hasard pour la liste des articles fournis.
Plus haut alors le nombre total de champions utilisera simplement tous les champions énumérés.

options.name: Enabled Checks
options.doc:
Which check types are active for each champion?
All check types are enabled by default: "Dragon", "Herald", "Baron", "Tower", "Inhibitor", 
"Game Win", "Assists", "Kills", "Creep Score", "Vision Score"
To recreate the old ARAM mode, use: "Tower", "Inhibitor", "Game Win", "Assists", "Kills"

options.name: Support Special Treatment
options.doc:
When enabled, support-role champions will not receive Kill and Creep Score checks,
and Vision Score checks will only apply to support champions.
(This was enabled by default on version <=0.2.0)
Disable this to give all champions identical checks.
options.doc_fr:
Une fois activés, les champions du rôle de soutien ne recevront pas de vérifications des points Kill et Creep, et les vérifications des points Vision ne s'appliqueront qu'aux champions du soutien.
(Ceci a été activé par défaut sur la version <=0.2.0)
Désactiver ceci pour donner à tous les champions des contrôles identiques.

options.name: Win Completes Champion
options.doc:
If enabled, winning a game with a champion (Enemy Nexus Destroyed check) will
automatically complete all remaining checks for that champion.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, gagner un match avec un champion (Enimy Nexus Detroyed check) effectuera automatiquement tous les contrôles restants pour ce champion.
